description:
Set the project's narrator TTS voice — required before generate_voiceover
    whenever the script has narration. Browse ids with list_voices. (Character
    dialogue voices are separate: set_character_voice.)

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

voice_id.description: TTS voice ID for the narrator, from list_voices (use the provider matching the project's voice_tts_provider)
voice_id.title: Voice Id

name: set_narrator_voice
title: Set narrator voice
